annual.cfx_source: Each annual report states the prior-year-FX revenue: FY2022 €889,049k, FY2023 €1,158,675k, FY2024 €1,280,616k; FY2025 states +11.5% directly. FY2021 states no constant-currency total.
annual.fy2020_ex_ifrs16_note: The 2020 report calls 41,759 'normalised EBITDA' and the 2021 report relabels the same number 'EBITDA excluding IFRS 16', but its own footnote says it also strips a 31,727 inventory provision. It is therefore on a different basis from the 2021-2023 figures and is not published here.

geography_h1_eur_k.representation_note: Through H1 2024 the issuer printed four rows -- Europe (excluding Italy), Italy, Americas, Asia. From H1 2025 it prints three, with Italy folded into Europe and the prior year re-presented on the new basis. The change is stated nowhere in words: 152,959 + 68,093 = 221,052 is the only evidence. Europe here is Total Europe throughout, reconstructed by adding the Italy row back for 2021-2024; all six years sum exactly to the printed total.

growth_h1_pct.note: Each half as its own half-year report printed it against the same half a year earlier: 2016 +9.7% / +10.3% at constant rates (revenues at constant rates EUR 221,029k); 2017 +10.7% / +9.7% (EUR 241,217k); 2018 +9.0% / +11.9% (EUR 276,777k), both against the IFRS 15 restated first half of 2017 (EUR 247,238k); 2019 +8.1% / +7.2% (EUR 288,835k); 2020 -29.6% / -29.8% (EUR 204.4 million). The 2021 report gives +52.9% against 2020 but a constant-rate rate only against the first half of 2019 (+10.0%), so 2021 has no constant-rate figure on this basis and stays null. 2022-2026 unchanged.

guidance_basis_census.note: Counted across every quantified forward statement in the eighteen results calls. Every row whose FX basis is stated is dated 2025-12-10 or later; no statement before that date names a basis.

annual_revenue_guidance.basis_note: Through FY2024 the company never says which currency basis its revenue target is on, so each year is shown against both actuals. From the December 2025 revision it states two legs at once -- about +10% reported and +11% to +12% at constant rates -- and from February 2026 the target is stated at constant rates only.
annual_revenue_guidance.pairing_warning: A target must be settled against the actual on its own basis. Pairing the constant-rate leg with reported revenue turns FY2025's met guidance into a phantom miss, and does the same to the first half of 2026.

strict_judgeability.note: Counted over every completed quantified target in the filings, not only revenue growth. All 47 were met. But only 6 state a currency basis, so on a strict reading the other 41 cannot be scored at all -- which is the more informative number.

ifrs16_disclosure_decay.note: The line that separates lease accounting from operating margin was published on both bases with a reconciling bridge through H1 2023, without the bridge in H1 2024, discontinued as an alternative performance measure in H1 2025, and the 2026 release prints no EBITDA at all.
